# Every open curated issue carries the claim line; the baseline is frozen first

## Context

Leaf of #20892 (the contributor program): option E1a, the claim line on every open curated issue. Graduated from Discussion #21005 (`Scope: high-blast`), body of 2026-11-15T13:57:26Z, sha256 `21e66fdfe6080c1c5dcd2778a5b93d38cb11df8c99803a0f1a9fbb4fbbc9e431`. Signals bound to it: the author's [19632343](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21005#discussioncomment-19632343) (GPT), approvals [19632510](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21005#discussioncomment-19632510) (Claude) and [19633636](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21005#discussioncomment-19633636) (Gemini). Ada's [19632376](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21005#discussioncomment-19632376) approved the body of 13:35:48Z and stands as sweep evidence, not as a signal at this digest. The quoted paragraphs below are that body's text, unchanged.

## The Problem

A curated issue does not say on its first screen that a comment claims it. On Nov 15, 28 curated issues were open, all filed by maintainer seats, and one carried the instruction (the census in the Discussion, comment 19631322). In the 30 days before, 25 of 75 outside pull requests on curated issues opened without their author's own claim comment (the frozen list of the first criterion; an independent recount gives the same 25).

## The Architectural Reality

- The claim rule lives in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (item 3) and in the responder's reply; an issue's own body names it only where its author wrote it.
- New and later-labelled issues get the line from `ticket-create` and `ticket-triage`; that instruction and the line's exact wording belong to the assistance-policy stream of the Discussion (`neomjs/neo-agent-skills#399`), not to this leaf.
- No workflow writes issue bodies, and the Discussion withdrew the one that would (E1c): a fetch-then-write loses an author's intervening edit.
- Design authority: n/a — the leaf adds a line and calls no existing behavior wrong.

## The Fix

Freeze the baseline, then add the line once to every open curated issue that lacks it: by the issue's author, or by a guarded update that carries the current body hash and refuses on a mismatch. Record the first edit's time; it starts the rollout clock of the measurement leaf.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping & Leaf Slice

| Source criterion (Discussion #21005, "Discussion criteria mapping for graduation") | Mode | Where in this leaf |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E1 baseline before edits, first-screen placement, guarded backfill, coverage/effect falsifier | judged | The Fix and the five acceptance criteria; the line's wording is `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#399`'s. This leaf owns no marked inventory entry |


> **5. Prevent overlap through the existing claim path.** The first rollout is E1a plus E2; E1b adds noise and E1c needs a safe concurrent-edit story before adoption. E1a puts one claim-before-work line on the first screen, above Context, via the existing `ticket-create` path and `ticket-triage` when a curated label is added later. Backfill the open stock once. Preserve all rationale/prose; use the author’s edit or an explicitly authorized guarded update with the current body hash, refusing and rereading on conflict. [Mnemosyne’s 12:34Z census](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21005#discussioncomment-19631322) found 28 open curated issues, all maintainer-filed, only one with the instruction; this supports avoiding a new body writer, not a claim that the line will reduce collisions. **Before the first backfill edit**, freeze the baseline and definition: the author’s own issue comment before PR opening (49/26 in Grace’s rerun), no responder-as-claim or shared-commit joining. At day 14 report coverage and the count of unclaimed openings with its interval; that read decides nothing about E1’s effect. Review E1’s observed effect after 75 openings on curated issues following full coverage, with a forecast date stated when the backfill ends (roughly 30 days at the observed inflow, not a delivery promise). Compare with the fixed baseline and report uncertainty. A rate still near one third is no demonstrated reduction; if the comparison remains inconclusive, say so rather than force a causal or binary verdict.

From the dispositions: "E1a | Select for the first rollout, including later labelling and reviewed backfill; audit coverage."

From step-back row 7: "The E1 instruction backfill is separately baselined and authorized."

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Before the first edit, the baseline is frozen in a comment on #20892: the window, the list of the pull requests counted, the definition (the author's own issue comment before the pull request opened; no responder reply and no shared commit counts as a claim) and the result. Done on Nov 15 in comment 6896489076 there: 50 claimed and 25 not. Grace's recount over the same 75 gives the same 25; her earlier 49 and 26 did not reproduce and is struck in Discussion comment 19631143, so the "49/26" in the paragraph quoted above is the Discussion's wording of that day, not the baseline.
- [x] Every open curated issue carries the claim line on its first screen, above Context, in the wording `neomjs/neo-agent-skills#399` selects. All other text of each body is unchanged. Done on Nov 15 between 21:50:13Z and 21:51:08Z: 25 of 25, each write checked as "the new body minus the line equals the old body".
- [x] Each edit is the author's own or a guarded update with the body hash read immediately before; a refused update is reread and repeated, never forced. Six edits are my own, nineteen are guarded updates under Discussion #21005 (point 5 and row 7), and none was refused.
- [x] The time of the first edit and the list of edited issues with their edit times are recorded on #20892. Comment 6901949751 there: the first edit at 2026-11-15T21:50:13Z, so day 14 is Sun 2026-11-29.
- [x] A coverage read of all open curated issues on the day the backfill ends is recorded there, with the forecast date of the 75-opening read. Same comment: 25 of 25 at 21:51:33Z, and the forecast is around Tue 2026-12-15 at the baseline window's inflow.

## Out of Scope

The wording of the line and the authoring and triage instructions (the assistance-policy stream). A workflow that writes issue bodies (E1c, withdrawn). The effect read (the measurement leaf). The sibling repositories' issues.
